title: Code Requests
intro: Ten messages mention codes. One minute. Some were really sent to you.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Sorry! I sent my login code to your number by mistake. Can you read it out to me?
cards.why: A code sent "by mistake" is a trick to get you to hand over your own.

cards.text: Your login code is 482913. Never share it with anyone, including Orrin staff. You just tried to log in.
cards.why: You just tried to log in, and the text warns you never to share it.

cards.text: I am at your door. Tell me the 6-digit code you just got to hand over your parcel.
cards.why: A stranger asking you to read out a code that you did not request.

cards.text: Hey, locked out of my account. Can you get a code on your phone for me? Pls urgent
cards.why: A friend's account may be taken over. Ask by phone before doing anything.

cards.text: Your order code is 773104. Show it at the shop to collect your lamp.
cards.why: You ordered it yourself, and the code is for showing in person.

cards.text: To fix your account, send us the verification code on your screen.
cards.why: No real support asks you to send them your code.

cards.text: Your code to log into the Vantel app is 118267. Do not share it with anyone.
cards.why: You were logging in, and the message says not to share it.

cards.text: You won! To claim, reply with the code we just texted you.
cards.why: A prize that needs your code is a trap.

cards.text: New sign-in on your account. If this was you, no action needed. If not, open the Orrin app.
cards.why: It asks for nothing and sends you to your own app.

cards.text: To send your money, I need the code your bank texted you. Tell me it now.
cards.why: You never receive money by giving someone a code.

golden_rule: A code is a key to your account. Never read it out or send it to anyone who asks.

quick_check.q: Someone says they sent a code to your phone by mistake and asks you to read it out. What do you do?

options.text: Read it, it is not yours
Read it but change your password later
Do not share it. Delete the message

quick_check.explain: A code sent "by mistake" is the trick. Never share a code.
